description: Closeup profile of Georgia O'Keeffe in a bandana and black brimmed hat with Ross behind her by the river.  This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Georgia O'Keeffe and Kenny Ross
